Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the shared occupation as "film editor" based on an incomplete synthesis of the gathered data. While the search results for Aram Avakian explicitly listed him as an "editor and director," the search results for Chris Menges clearly stated he was a "cinematographer and film director." The Planner failed to recognize that "film director" was the common occupation shared by both individuals, instead prioritizing the "editor" role for Avakian without verifying if Menges held that specific role (which the search results did not support). This represents a failure to correctly intersect the sets of occupations retrieved for both subjects, leading to an erroneous conclusion.
